1. Why is my washer producing an odour? 1. Odours are often caused by keeping the door closed between loads, trapping moisture. Run a cleaning cycle with hot water and white vinegar or baking soda, and leave the door open, per.
2. Why won't my washing machine turn on? 2. Check if the circuit breaker has tripped or if the GFCI outlet needs to be reset. Also, verify that the lid or door is properly latched.
3. Why is there lint/residue on my clothes? 3. Undissolved detergent residue may appear as lint. Try reducing the amount of detergent used, especially in high-efficiency (HE) machines.
4. How can I make my laundry more energy-efficient? 4. Wash with cold water, wash full loads (without overloading), and clean the dryer lint filter regularly.
5. What should I do if my machine is shaking or unbalanced? 5. Ensure the machine is level by adjusting the legs, measuring from both the side and front.
6. Why is my washing machine not filling with water? 6. This often indicates a faulty inlet valve, which may need to be replaced.
7. What is my right if a new machine breaks down? 7. If a machine breaks down within the warranty period, the store is obligated to repair it; refusal to do so violates the consumer’s "right to seek redressal".
